jobDescription: The warehouse control system directs the conveyors, sorters and pick stations in the company's distribution centres. The Software Engineer implements control system changes against the operations specifications, tests them on the emulation rig, takes changes through the software review process, supports the distribution centres' support desk with diagnostics, and documents each change's boundaries. Release approval stays with the control system lead. Reports to the control system lead; works with the operations specialists, the site support desks and the automation vendor.
requirements: Implements control system changes against the operations specifications under the software standard.
Tests changes on the emulation rig with a documented test record.
Takes changes through the software review process, with release approval staying with the control system lead.
Supports the site support desks with diagnostics and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents each change's limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Software engineer on the warehouse control system team of a retail distribution company for four years, implementing control system changes against the operations specialists' specifications under the team's software standard; forty-four changes in the period, each on a change record in my name.
Tested each change on the emulation rig with the test record attached to the change record and checked by a second engineer.
Took each change through the software review process; the release approval was the control system lead's, recorded on the change record.
Supported the three distribution centres' support desks with diagnostics through the support queue, recording which incidents I diagnosed and which were passed to the automation vendor.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each change in the change record's closure section.
Work sample: three change records with their test records, review records and release approvals, and one month's support queue log, with the change system references as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former control system lead: confirmed the candidate implemented and tested the changes in the period, with release approval staying with the lead, and confirmed the employment dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is available for the on-site technical exercise on the proposed date and confirmed the on-call rota expectations were discussed; no relocation needed.
